title: The Hidden Hedging Flow That Pushes the Market Around
speaker: Brent Kochuba (SpotGamma)

macro_themes.view: After a sleepy few weeks and a big OPEX clearing positions, catalysts like Meta and the midterms should get markets moving a lot more.
Most index options flow is zero-day, so gamma signals are often only 1-2 day signals; longer-dated flow and term structure matter more for swing trades.
Iran risk, oil and rising rates make the environment unclear, so traders should wait for their best setups.

calls.reason: Realized vol was very low into OPEX; with positions cleared and catalysts (Meta, midterms) ahead, he expects tech to move and sees potential explosive upside, favoring November tech calls.
calls.quote: this is a really nice time to look at maybe buying some call options in tech for November ... we could really start to see some explosive upside
